image:free.why: ostree: / is the composefs overlay, a read-only EROFS image that df always shows 100% full; the physical root's btrfs shows at /etc and /var (docs/design/bazzite.md, What B7 found)

after:boot-state.why: systemd-remount-fs fails at every boot on ostree (below), so the system is degraded (bazzite.md, What B1 found)

after:failed-units.why: it remounts / with fstab's options and the composefs overlay refuses ("No changes allowed in reconfigure"); every boot, the Thinkpad's fstab the same (bazzite.md, What B1 found)

after:fstab.why: Anaconda's ostree fstab lists /home (a link to var/home) before /var; findmnt resolves the link, systemd orders the mounts itself, and HoltTest1 sees the same on source and restore (bazzite.md, What B6 found)
